summary: feat(admin-panel): disable accounts that match a blocklist entry
description:
Because:

* A new blocklist entry does not affect accounts that already exist.

This commit:

* Moves the account disable logic into a shared AccountStateService
* Adds disable-matching routes to the email and domain blocklists
* Adds a checkbox and a row button to disable matching accounts
* Matches the current primary email and blocks repeated row clicks
* Shows how many accounts were disabled

Closes FXA-14912
